title: I have a mall dream!
content: All right, buckle up kiddies, I have a good one for ya - ok, so I was driving with my Grandpa in his old yellow farm truck - like I knew it wasn't really my grandpa, somehow (?) so I was just in the passenger seat but like, he passed away when I was I think twelve and he was greatest Grandpa that ever existed, sorry everybody I won - so he was driving and we were in the country somewhere, seems like there were trees and/or some combination of trees and fields - the sun was out and I remember the outside being very green and leafy. So we pull up this outdoor mall-type place, it had colored fabric hung up as walls to separate the shops, I remember the fabric was like a garnet (lol, I looked up the colors of red so I could get it right, for the visualization) color with some light pattern on it - anyway, the shops were all manned with tiny Cheech Marin look-alikes, they all looked like miniature Cheech Marins and they didn't say anything, they may or may not have been wearing overalls. So Grandpa-not-grandpa drops me off and I start walking through the outdoor mall, with these weird little emotionless Cheech Marins just looking at me, whatever, dream me wasn't worried about the Cheeches, they were just there. All the sudden, I'm in a regular, mall, seemed like a nicer one - it's busy and I feel like I'm shorter than everybody somehow, there's a big crowd but I can't really see any of the stores, I'm just in this maze of super tall people, that my mind is telling me were wearing a lot of gray suits but I don't know if that's legit. I seem to remember going up some stairs then and next thing I know I'm in like, a small oval conference-type room, there was a wood table with kind of cream-colored office type chairs, the walls were gray, and there was some woman with a clip board in business casual sitting at the head of the table, which was on my left. Behind her left shoulder was a door, and there was another door behind me, where I guess I came in. There were other people there but I didn't really pay any attention to them, they were just there. I think we were seated and then it gets blurry but I remember I guess it was my turn or whatever, and the door behind her left shoulder opens and it's like, an indoor track with this red lighting (???) so I think there were people in there, walking the track and this girl comes out and then I remember being just, filled with this rage and screaming at this girl, just screaming at her with every bit of rage that I could muster, while the woman with the clipboard watched. So, at the end I was screaming at this girl DECIDE DECIDE DECIDE DECIDE and she was shaking her head no, she wouldn't decide. So the girl gets up and goes back to the walking track and the next thing I see is this manilla envelope with the word UNDECIDED written on it. So THEN (and I swear to the Lord above this is a real dream, I keep remembering more of it) I guess it was the next person's turn, so I was sat back at the table and I was looking at this like, semi-annoyed businesswoman and I remember i said "are you God???" and you know how like, when the question is so stupid it hurts you to answer, she like, rubbed the bridge of her nose and sighed out this "yes" and I said "how many of you are there" and she said "three". AND THEN one of the little Cheech Marins came in and said "your dog is here" and I knew somehow my dog Lucky had FOLLOWED ME, so I tear up off the chair and knock over a bunch of little emotionless Cheech Marins and run into the kitchen, somehow I knew where that was, and there was this huge black, like, cast Iron oven and I was ripping open the doors and they were filled with lasagnas, tiny Cheech Marins love lasagna, and then I looked under this like, metal rolling cart, and there he was, there was my dog, looking freaked out and hiding under a table. The instant I saw him it was fine again, I knew he could make his way back and wasn't worried anymore. So then it was time to leave - back through the mall, which was now empty - I remember going to the stairs and I started to go down them and this voice in my head said - no, always go up, so i went up and finally found this door that led into this, looked like a hair salon with all these chairs, and there was a glass door at the other end, so I climbed over all these chairs and I remember there was a receptionist at a desk next to the door who looked very surprised to see me - I asked her where the door was (idk) and she pointed to where it obviously was, and I ripped open the door and I remember the sun was out so the first thing I did was fall onto this concrete and just lay in the sun gasping for air. I just laid in the sun for I don't even know how long, grateful as I have ever been in my life, and then I looked up and all the little outdoor Cheech Marins were watching me, so I walked over to one and he offered me a toke of his, looked like a ceramic joint, which I took and then I woke up. Honestly didn't intend to write a book, but the more I talked about it the more I remembered, thank you for taking the time to read it :)
